rca of the issue: RCA for /api/media/images malformed upload: media.py catches UnidentifiedImageError/ValueError/OSError/etc, but PIL can raise SyntaxError for certain broken PNG CRC/header cases during image.verify(). This exception is currently uncaught, propagates to FastAPI, and returns 500. Mitigation: include SyntaxError in except tuple and return HTTP 400 with same validation message.
